FINAL ANSWER: The average number of CHIP variants per sample after filtering out intronic, intergenic, and UTR variants is ≈ 52.3 variants per sample (4,497 qualifying variants across 86 samples; mean 52.29, median 52, range 39–66).

Executed analysis (script: analysis_chip_variants.py; per-sample table: per_sample_chip_variant_counts.csv):
- Parsed all 86 workbooks in data/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS (57,258 data rows, rows 3+ of each single sheet).
- Main rule (as approved): counted rows with Zygosity ∈ {Heterozygous, Homozygous Variant} whose Sequence Ontology (Combined) term is outside the exclusion set {intron_variant, 3_prime_UTR_variant, 5_prime_UTR_variant, 5_prime_UTR_premature_start_codon_gain_variant, upstream_gene_variant}. Combined SO terms handled by defensive comma-splitting (0 multi-term rows found in practice).
- Result: total kept = 4,497 variants; per-sample mean = 4,497/86 = 52.2907 ≈ 52.3; median = 52; min = 39 (SRR5469979); max = 66 (SRR5463506). Full per-sample counts reported (range 39–66; e.g., 179-P1:46, 502-P1:50, SRR6447679:53).

Sensitivity analysis (Zygosity = None rows that survive the SO filter): 500 such rows exist corpus-wide (of 1,151 None rows; the rest are UTR/intron and removed). They raise the mean to 58.10 (median 53). The effect is dominated by a single sample, 380-P, which carries 250 None-Zygosity rows in coding regions (129 synonymous, 90 missense, 25 splice_region, 4 inframe_insertion, 1 inframe_deletion, 1 frameshift, 1 upstream already excluded); sensitivity max = 301 (380-P). Under the approved main rule these None rows are NOT counted, so the headline figure remains 52.3.

Cross-diagnostic vs the CHIP gene list (230214_Schenz_et_al_2022_CHIP_Genes.xlsx, 56 gene symbols): retained variants map to 52 distinct gene labels, covering 46/56 CHIP-list genes; top genes NOTCH1 (404), SETBP1 (328), PDGFRA (312), CUX1 (281), FLT3 (261), SF3B1 (232). The In_CHIP column (col AD) was observed True in inspected rows, consistent with the panel scope.

Documented decisions per your instructions: U1 — upstream_gene_variant excluded as the intergenic equivalent (intergenic_variant itself is absent from the data); U2 — 5_prime_UTR_premature_start_codon_gain_variant treated as UTR and excluded; U3 — denominator is all 86 CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS samples (no trio restriction); U4 — actual data rows counted, not the sheet-name label. Splice_region_variant was not excluded (not intronic per the question wording).

payload.answer_summary: Average = 52.3 CHIP variants per sample (4497 variants / 86 samples) after excluding intronic, intergenic (upstream_gene_variant) and UTR variants, counting Heterozygous/Homozygous Variant rows only.
